label.explanation: ingest-api v3.31.0 rolled out shortly before onset (lines 133, 143). Right after, ingest-api started throwing a TypeError in the new formatter code, tagged with v3.31.0 (lines 149, 156, 169, 184). Only requests that hit that path fail, so most traffic still succeeds and the ingest-gateway 500s are partial (lines 161, 170, 191, 209, 222, 233, 254). It looks like bad input data, but the field is missing for any event without 'region' — a code regression. Roll back to v3.30.7. Red herrings: line 61 (a routine disk usage warning on the log volume, nowhere near full).
